patch.description: Qualify one rights-reviewed industrial CAD receiver/profile with representative import/export/round trips across all seven recipes and supported options/grades. Preserve the fixed 0.001 cm geometry gate, units, piece/grade identity and relations, seams/marks, malformed-input rejection, repeatability, readable rendered output, legacy DXF and protected export identities. Do not infer ANSI/AAMA or ASTM conformance from a vendor menu label. GetonAgain DGS VID:20250610 and GMS are open past sign-in; both documents were empty at the S660 check. S661 starts one falsifiable pilot: copy/hash-check the generic AC1014 S648 Polo M fixture, then import once through the observed DGS AUTOCAD mode with frozen S659 settings. The source is not a documented profile match or compatibility claim. Use independent numeric DXF parsing and actual rendered output; identity/seam/grade relationship claims require a verified version-matched C04 sidecar. The DGS manual says RUL export omits quilt/sew lines; inspect the export dialog once and stop if no documented geometry-bearing non-RUL route is available. Preserve the current maintainer-approved C:\G04-CLO-DXF-Exchange\<slice-folder> custody root. Do not generalize any result beyond this exact input/build/mode/settings. No V03 gate passes unless the evidence meets its existing criterion. See S661 and S660 packets under docs/research/epic17/ and S659's exact build record.
